Name: Moon Misadventures
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Want to go to the moon? Now you can!

[youtube]r3DWiJnoppg[/youtube]

This mod is a work in progress.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Visit the dwarf and repair an ancient vehicle of his with late-game materials, and visit the moon for a new challenge.

This mod includes two new tool tiers (the highest pickaxe is needed to access certain areas), a new accessory type and slot for it, a new dungeon, and some other stuff. Full details on the GitHub readme.


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
